verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no official language SDKs. What it does show is a documented Machines REST API for provisioning and managing apps, machines and volumes, plus the official flyctl CLI, so developers can build programmatically but must write their own client code. No published OpenAPI spec was found, which would have allowed generating one. Missing for 10: any official SDK (e.g. Node/Python/Go client libraries), SDK documentation, a published OpenAPI spec for client generation, and independent corroboration of SDK-based development.
